context:
Goal: every idle session hands off and is archived, losing no work (owner, 09:18 CST Nov 10).
Problem (rule): the archive guard refuses a session with an open PR or a pushed branch ahead of main, and only your typed override passes it.
Based on (measured): the collector's log.tsv on branch archive/session-handoffs-2026-11-10, column 5: about 57 were refused for an open PR or a pushed branch ahead with no PR, and about 13 because gh could not read the PR.
Based on (read): archiving keeps the PR, the branch and the transcript, and an archived session can be unarchived.
Departs from: main (the guard keeps all 70 live) — your override archives them, with their PRs left as drafts.
Meanwhile: the collector waits on this answer and on item 487 (how to collect the handoffs of the 213 sessions that never replied).
home: step freeze handoffs; collector branch archive/session-handoffs-2026-11-10

title: The guard refused to archive 70 sessions whose handoffs are stored. Archive them anyway?
why: The collector stored each handoff, so archiving loses no work, but 13 have a PR state no one has read.
